key_insight: Sage-Med-Preview reports stronger medical multimodal performance through progressive training, while model-size scaling alone mainly improves text capabilities.
clinical_relevance: The findings suggest potential for medical image understanding and report generation, but do not establish safety or effectiveness in clinical care.
method: Stage-specific data curation over 322.7 million candidate records.
Medical pretraining, staged supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning.
evidence_signal: Evaluation against 77 competing models covered 238 tasks across 61 public and 13 private benchmarks; the model averaged 58.26% on 31 public multimodal benchmarks versus 50.99% for Hulu-Med-235B-A22B and 52.24% for Intern-S2-Preview.
watch_item: Complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows remain challenging, limiting extrapolation from benchmark results to clinical deployment.
